lamina.name: Health Risk
lamina.description: A frame for disease risk: entered test results and history, the weekly activity dose from the Daily Activity lamina, placeholder risk models and screening flags. Every model is a placeholder until an expert replaces it.

attribute.name: Age
attribute.description: Age in years.

attribute.name: Sex
attribute.description: 1 for male, 0 for female. Risk models weigh the two differently.

attribute.name: Height
attribute.description: Standing height.

attribute.name: Body mass
attribute.description: Body mass.

attribute.name: Systolic blood pressure
attribute.description: Resting systolic blood pressure, seated.

attribute.name: Diastolic blood pressure
attribute.description: Resting diastolic blood pressure, seated.

attribute.name: Total cholesterol
attribute.description: Total cholesterol from a blood test.

attribute.name: HDL cholesterol
attribute.description: HDL cholesterol from the same blood test.

attribute.name: Fasting glucose
attribute.description: Fasting blood glucose.

attribute.name: Smokes now
attribute.description: 1 if the person smokes now, 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Diagnosed diabetes
attribute.description: 1 if diabetes has been diagnosed, 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Takes blood-pressure medicine
attribute.description: 1 if the person takes medicine for blood pressure, 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Close relative with diabetes
attribute.description: 1 if a parent, brother or sister has diabetes, 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Takes a heart-rate-lowering medicine
attribute.description: 1 if the person takes a medicine that lowers heart rate, such as a beta blocker; 0 otherwise.

attribute.name: Weekly activity now
attribute.description: The weekly activity dose this person records now: the median week of their recordings, from the Daily Activity lamina.

attribute.name: Weekly activity with the plan
attribute.description: The weekly activity dose the plan would give, projected by the Daily Activity lamina.

attribute.name: CVD weight: log age
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on the logarithm of age in the cardiovascular score.

attribute.name: CVD weight: log systolic pressure
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on the logarithm of systolic blood pressure.

attribute.name: CVD weight: log total cholesterol
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on the logarithm of total cholesterol.

attribute.name: CVD weight: log HDL cholesterol
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on the logarithm of HDL cholesterol; negative because more HDL goes with lower risk.

attribute.name: CVD weight: smoking
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added to the cardiovascular score for a current smoker.

attribute.name: CVD weight: diabetes
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added to the cardiovascular score for diagnosed diabetes.

attribute.name: CVD weight: blood-pressure medicine
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added to the cardiovascular score for treated blood pressure.

attribute.name: CVD weight: male
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added to the cardiovascular score for a male.

attribute.name: CVD baseline survival
attribute.description: Placeholder. Share of reference people free of cardiovascular disease over the period.

attribute.name: CVD reference score
attribute.description: Placeholder. The score of the reference person: a 50-year-old woman, systolic 125, total cholesterol 5.2, HDL 1.3, no other factor.

attribute.name: Diabetes score: constant
attribute.description: Placeholder. Constant of the diabetes score.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: age
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on age.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: body mass index
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on body mass index.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: fasting glucose
attribute.description: Placeholder. Weight on fasting glucose.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: family history
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added for a close relative with diabetes.

attribute.name: Diabetes weight: blood-pressure medicine
attribute.description: Placeholder. Added for treated blood pressure.

attribute.name: CVD: largest reduction from activity
attribute.description: Placeholder. The share by which the relative risk of cardiovascular disease falls at very high weekly activity.

attribute.name: CVD: activity scale
attribute.description: Placeholder. The weekly dose at which about two thirds of the largest reduction is reached.

attribute.name: Diabetes: largest reduction from activity
attribute.description: Placeholder. The share by which the relative risk of type 2 diabetes falls at very high weekly activity.

attribute.name: Diabetes: activity scale
attribute.description: Placeholder. The weekly dose at which about two thirds of the largest reduction is reached.

attribute.name: Flag threshold: systolic pressure
attribute.description: Placeholder. Resting systolic pressure at or above which the blood-pressure flag is raised.

attribute.name: Flag threshold: diastolic pressure
attribute.description: Placeholder. Resting diastolic pressure at or above which the blood-pressure flag is raised.

attribute.name: Flag threshold: jump in weekly activity
attribute.description: Placeholder. A plan whose weekly dose exceeds the current dose by this factor raises the jump flag.

attribute.name: Guideline range: lower end
attribute.description: Placeholder. Lower end of the weekly activity range guidance recommends.

attribute.name: Guideline range: upper end
attribute.description: Placeholder. Upper end of the weekly activity range guidance recommends.

attribute.name: Body mass index
attribute.description: Body mass divided by the square of height in metres.

attribute.name: Cardiovascular score
attribute.depends_on: age, sbp, chol_total, chol_hdl, smoker, diabetes, bp_treated, sex_male, c_age, c_sbp, c_tc, c_hdl, c_smoker, c_diabetes, c_treated, c_male
attribute.description: The weighted sum the cardiovascular risk is read from. Placeholder.

attribute.name: Cardiovascular risk now
attribute.description: Chance of cardiovascular disease over the period, on the entered figures. Placeholder.

attribute.name: Diabetes score
attribute.depends_on: age, BMI, glucose_fasting, family_diabetes, bp_treated, d_0, d_age, d_bmi, d_glucose, d_family, d_treated
attribute.description: The weighted sum the diabetes risk is read from. Placeholder.

attribute.name: Type 2 diabetes risk now
attribute.description: Chance of type 2 diabetes over the period, on the entered figures. Placeholder.

attribute.name: CVD relative risk at the current activity
attribute.description: Relative risk of cardiovascular disease at the current weekly dose, against no activity. Placeholder.

attribute.name: CVD relative risk with the plan
attribute.description: Relative risk of cardiovascular disease at the planned weekly dose, against no activity. Placeholder.

attribute.name: Diabetes relative risk at the current activity
attribute.description: Relative risk of type 2 diabetes at the current weekly dose, against no activity. Placeholder.

attribute.name: Diabetes relative risk with the plan
attribute.description: Relative risk of type 2 diabetes at the planned weekly dose, against no activity. Placeholder.

attribute.name: Cardiovascular risk with the plan
attribute.description: The risk now, moved by the ratio of relative risk at the planned dose to that at the current dose. Placeholder.

attribute.name: Type 2 diabetes risk with the plan
attribute.description: The risk now, moved by the ratio of relative risk at the planned dose to that at the current dose. Placeholder.

attribute.name: Blood pressure flag
attribute.description: 1 when resting blood pressure is at or above either threshold. Placeholder thresholds.

attribute.name: Jump in activity flag
attribute.description: 1 when the plan's weekly dose exceeds the current dose by more than the declared factor. Placeholder threshold.

attribute.name: Heart-rate medicine flag
attribute.description: 1 when the person takes a heart-rate-lowering medicine, so heart-rate targets do not describe their effort.

function.name: Cardiovascular score
function.formula: cvd_lp = c_age*ln(age) + c_sbp*ln(sbp) + c_tc*ln(chol_total) + c_hdl*ln(chol_hdl) + c_smoker*smoker + c_diabetes*diabetes + c_treated*bp_treated + c_male*sex_male
function.inputs: age, sbp, chol_total, chol_hdl, smoker, diabetes, bp_treated, sex_male, c_age, c_sbp, c_tc, c_hdl, c_smoker, c_diabetes, c_treated, c_male
function.source: Invented coefficients in the shape of a survival-model risk equation. Not a published equation.
function.description: A weighted sum of the entered figures. To be replaced by the equation an expert chooses.

function.name: Cardiovascular risk now
function.source: The usual survival form; the baseline survival and reference score are invented.
function.description: Turns the score into a chance over the period.

function.name: Diabetes score
function.formula: dm_lp = d_0 + d_age*age + d_bmi*BMI + d_glucose*glucose_fasting + d_family*family_diabetes + d_treated*bp_treated
function.inputs: age, BMI, glucose_fasting, family_diabetes, bp_treated, d_0, d_age, d_bmi, d_glucose, d_family, d_treated
function.source: Invented coefficients in the shape of a logistic risk score. Not a published equation.
function.description: A weighted sum of the entered figures. To be replaced by the score an expert chooses.

function.name: Type 2 diabetes risk now
function.description: Turns the score into a chance over the period.

function.name: CVD relative risk at the current activity
function.source: Invented curve with the saturating shape dose-response studies report. Not a published curve.
function.description: Relative risk falls quickly with the first hours of weekly activity and flattens.

function.name: CVD relative risk with the plan
function.source: Invented curve with the saturating shape dose-response studies report. Not a published curve.
function.description: The same curve, read at the planned dose.

function.name: Diabetes relative risk at the current activity
function.source: Invented curve with the saturating shape dose-response studies report. Not a published curve.
function.description: Relative risk falls quickly with the first hours of weekly activity and flattens.

function.name: Diabetes relative risk with the plan
function.source: Invented curve with the saturating shape dose-response studies report. Not a published curve.
function.description: The same curve, read at the planned dose.

function.name: Cardiovascular risk with the plan
function.source: A relative risk applied to a survival probability as a hazard ratio: an approximation.
function.description: Moves the risk now by the ratio of the two relative risks. A plan below the current activity raises it.

function.name: Type 2 diabetes risk with the plan
function.source: A relative risk applied to a survival probability as a hazard ratio: an approximation.
function.description: Moves the risk now by the ratio of the two relative risks. A plan below the current activity raises it.

function.name: Blood pressure flag
function.formula: flag_bp = 1 when sbp >= sbp_flag or dbp >= dbp_flag, else 0
function.source: Invented thresholds. To be replaced from named guidance.
function.description: Raised when resting blood pressure is at or above either threshold.

function.name: Jump in activity flag
function.formula: flag_dose_jump = 1 when dose_planned > dose_jump_ratio * dose_current, else 0
function.source: Invented threshold. To be replaced from named guidance.
function.description: Raised when the plan asks for much more weekly activity than the person does now.

function.name: Heart-rate medicine flag
function.source: A statement of fact about the entered answer.
function.description: Raised when the person takes a heart-rate-lowering medicine.

composite.name: Risk State
composite.description: The two risks on the entered figures.

segment.name: Entered by the person
segment.description: Test results and history the recordings cannot hold
segment.attributes: age, sex_male, height_cm, mass_kg, sbp, dbp, chol_total, chol_hdl, glucose_fasting, smoker, diabetes, bp_treated, family_diabetes, hr_medicine

segment.name: From the activity twin
segment.description: The weekly activity dose, measured and planned

segment.name: Model Coefficients
segment.description: Every number the placeholder models read. All invented; an expert replaces them here.
segment.attributes: c_age, c_sbp, c_tc, c_hdl, c_smoker, c_diabetes, c_treated, c_male, cvd_S0, cvd_lp_ref, d_0, d_age, d_bmi, d_glucose, d_family, d_treated, cvd_act_max, cvd_act_scale, dm_act_max, dm_act_scale, sbp_flag, dbp_flag, dose_jump_ratio, dose_guideline_low, dose_guideline_high

segment.name: Risk and Flags
segment.description: The chain from entered figures and weekly activity to risk and flags
segment.attributes: BMI, cvd_lp, cvd_risk_now, dm_lp, dm_risk_now, cvd_rr_current, cvd_rr_planned, dm_rr_current, dm_rr_planned, cvd_risk_plan, dm_risk_plan, flag_bp, flag_dose_jump, flag_medicine
segment.functions: body_mass_index, cvd_score, cvd_risk_now, dm_score, dm_risk_now, cvd_rr_current, cvd_rr_planned, dm_rr_current, dm_rr_planned, cvd_risk_plan, dm_risk_plan, flag_bp, flag_dose_jump, flag_medicine

result.not_applicable_text: Not shown: diabetes is already diagnosed.
